hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Minneapolis With Three Design Options
hero.subheadline: Sicora Design / Build draws every remodel at three price points, then builds it with its own project managers and Rift Sawn cabinet shop. The firm has served the west metro since 2000, now under owner Ron Sonnek.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Minneapolis area project in St. Louis Park with a Cambria island, soapstone perimeter counters, white cabinetry and GE Cafe appliances with champagne bronze handles

intro.h2: One firm for design, cabinets and construction
paragraphs: Sicora Design / Build has offered kitchen remodeling in Minneapolis and the west suburbs since Thomas Sicora founded the firm in 2000. Today owner Ron Sonnek leads a team of interior designers, project managers and cabinetmakers working from 5601 W Lake St. You get one point of contact from the first consultation to the warranty walkthrough.

What sets the process apart is choice. For each project the designers draw three plans, lite, medium and heavy, at different price ranges, with floor plans, renderings and a 3D virtual walk-through. You pick the level that fits, exact costs are set with the trade contractors, and the firm says projects land within 3% of budget on average.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Minneapolis, plus suites, basements and more

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Timeless layouts, smart storage and quality materials, from a 'Refreshed' kitchen with new quartz tops to a full 'Design & Build' plan with a new island. Recent St. Louis Park kitchens pair Cambria and soapstone, and one adds a red oak stained island and a hidden pantry.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in St. Louis Park, Minnesota with a red oak stained island, white cabinetry, globe pendants and a hidden pantry in modern farmhouse style

items.name: Owner's Suites and Bathrooms
items.blurb: Bedroom, bath and closet planned as one suite, with custom vanities, tile, lighting and storage, and in-floor heat at the top design level. A recent St. Louis Park owners' suite has his and her vanities with white quartz tops and maple cabinetry.

image.alt: Owners' suite bathroom remodel in St. Louis Park, Minnesota with a freestanding tub, glass shower and maple vanity with white quartz top

items.name: Basements
items.blurb: Unfinished lower levels turned into rooms the family actually uses. One case study took a walkout basement and made it the family's everyday hangout area, and other Sicora basements add wet bars, built-in media walls, game tables and wine storage.

image.alt: Finished basement with a quartz-topped game table, coffered wood ceiling, built-in TV wall and wine bar

items.name: Custom Cabinetry and Closets
items.blurb: Rift Sawn, Sicora's own cabinet and woodworking shop, builds kitchen cabinets, entertainment centers, bars, counters, shelving and built-ins, and no project is too big or too small. It also designs and installs custom closet systems at a more attainable price than typical luxury brands.

image.alt: Custom kitchen drawer with wood pan dividers holding skillets and baking sheets, in a St. Louis Park, Minnesota remodel

items.name: Porches, Living Spaces and Whole House
items.blurb: Porches, living rooms and whole-house remodels, including an all-season sun room addition and an Edina fireplace wall with a linear gas fireplace, custom ledge stone and tape lighting. Before-and-after pairs on the site show complete interior and exterior makeovers.

image.alt: Fireplace feature wall remodel in Edina, Minnesota with a linear gas fireplace, custom ledge stone blend and tape lighting

why_choose_us.h2: Why west metro homeowners keep coming back to Sicora

items.title: Three plans, three prices
items.text: You see lite, medium and heavy designs side by side, each with its own price range, so you can match your wish list to your budget early.

items.title: Budgets that hold
items.text: Exact costs are set after a site walk-through with the trade contractors, and the firm reports less than a 3% budget variance on average.

items.title: Warranty plus an 11-month visit
items.text: Every project carries a 2-year mechanical and 10-year structural warranty. A walkthrough is scheduled 11 months after completion to handle any repairs.

items.title: Clients who return
items.text: One Google reviewer's family has hired Sicora five times, for two major kitchen upgrades and three bedroom expansions. The firm is also an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm.

about.h2: Ron Sonnek and the Sicora team
about.text: Thomas Sicora founded the firm in 2000 to give homeowners timeless, custom design through a process that is engaging and transparent, which the company calls the Sicora difference. Ron Sonnek now owns the business. His team includes production manager Jim Gill, interior designers Darcy Dickman and Heidi Kinder, project manager Dave Stricker, Tim Nurkka on service and warranty, and four cabinetmakers in the Rift Sawn shop. Reviewers name Ron, Darcy and Jim for keeping design wishes and budgets in check and staying on top of progress.

process.h2: From consultation to the 11-month warranty walkthrough

steps.title: Consultation and assessment
steps.text: Book a phone, virtual or in-home meeting at least three days ahead. The team checks whether your project is feasible.

steps.title: Design (2 to 4 months)
steps.text: Designers develop lite, medium and heavy plans with floor plans, renderings and a 3D virtual walk-through of the space.

steps.title: Contract development
steps.text: Trade contractors walk the site, exact costs are set, you choose your options, and the contract is written from them.

steps.title: Construction (2 to 5 months)
steps.text: A pre-construction meeting with your designer and project manager starts the build, and an app shows progress, updates and changes.

steps.title: Warranty
steps.text: A punch list and walkthrough close the job, followed by the 2-year mechanical and 10-year structural warranty and an 11-month check-in.

service_area.h2: Serving St. Louis Park, Edina and the Lake Minnetonka area
service_area.text: Sicora works from 5601 W Lake St, where Minneapolis meets St. Louis Park. The firm names fourteen communities, from Minneapolis, Edina and Golden Valley out to Wayzata, Excelsior, Deephaven and the rest of the Lake Minnetonka area. Recent project photos come from St. Louis Park, Edina, Minneapolis and Minnetonka. If your town is not on the list, call the front desk to ask.

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost?
items.a: Sicora's ballpark guide for a 12 by 12 foot kitchen runs from about $38,000 for a 'Refreshed' kitchen with existing cabinets and new quartz tops, to $55,000 'Refaced,' $89,000 'Transformed' with new custom cabinets, and $102,000 and up for a full 'Design & Build' with a new layout and island.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost?
items.a: For a 6 by 10 foot bathroom, the guide lists about $29,000 for 'Clean,' $32,000 for 'Refresh' with tile flooring and $45,000 for 'Renew' with a custom vanity, granite top and tile surround. A full 'Design & Build' bath with in-floor heat is priced per project.

items.q: How long does a remodel take?
items.a: Design usually takes two to four months, because you review three plans, renderings and a 3D walk-through. Construction runs two to five months depending on the project. Contract development falls between the two, after trade contractors walk the site and exact costs are set.

Sicora provides a 2-year mechanical and 10-year structural warranty. About 11 months after your project is done, the team schedules a walkthrough for any repairs. If something comes up beyond those warranties, the firm asks you to tell them, since the goal is clients for life.

Yes. Sicora offers a free in-home consultation, and you can choose a phone or virtual meeting instead. Please book at least three days ahead. For an earlier slot, call the front desk at (952) 929-0098 and the team will do its best to fit you in.

final_cta.text: Call (952) 929-0098 or book a free in-home consultation online at least three days ahead.
